sentences.text: Two conditions, peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2B and rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 5, are both recorded as caused by the gene PEX5 [e_fe8ba553bdf6] [e_2f08386094bb].
Both gene links are curated, which means they come from the databases OMIM and Orphanet [e_fe8ba553bdf6] [e_2f08386094bb].
Constellate then computed that the two conditions share a causal gene, at confidence 0.9, the lower of the two gene links [e_844a5c20cf1d].
This shared-gene link is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it from the other two links [e_844a5c20cf1d].

Peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2B has two recorded features, a high level of long chain fatty acids in the blood and a type of cataract called polar cataract, each with low confidence of 0.5 [e_461243e6046d] [e_2df425f8fb7d].
The rhizomelic condition has one study listed, a recruiting registry on ClinicalTrials.gov [e_e51d1ba0bb5a].
These edges do not show that the two conditions look alike or behave alike, and they do not show anything about treatments [e_844a5c20cf1d] [e_e51d1ba0bb5a].
